intent: Thumbs up/down vote control for rating an AI response, with a trailing info affordance.
guidance: Controlled by the `vote` prop alone: pass `vote` and it reflects that value; omit `vote` and it keeps internal state. `onVote` fires on every change in both modes. Only one vote is active at a time, and clicking the active vote clears it back to null. The trailing Info button is a static affordance with no handler of its own — wire it host-side if you need it.
use_when: Collecting quick up/down feedback beneath an AI response.
A single toggleable sentiment where re-clicking the active vote clears it.
dont_use_when: A graded score (e.g. 1-5) — RatingBar is binary up/down only.
A persistent on/off setting — use Switch.

tokens.note: Button box size-[24px], icon 16px, and container mt-[4px] are hardcoded arbitrary values, not tokens.

a11y.role: three native <button>s (thumbs up, thumbs down, info); no wrapper role.
a11y.state: aria-pressed on each vote button reflects the active vote; the active vote clears on re-click.
a11y.focus: focus-visible ring bound to the focus-ring token.
